title: Phase Transitions and Hub Vulnerability in Networked Truth Recovery under Misinformation

contributions.purpose: 建立错误信息下分布式真相恢复的仿真模型
contributions.mechanism: 多智能体在 ca-GrQc 网络上以 redundancy-based 打分 + 矛盾消解更新信念,share budget B 限带宽
contributions.evaluation: 定性/规模:4158 节点、5 regime×多带宽×3 seed=93 run、15 万+ 记录
contributions.source_quote: We formalize a simulation model of distributed truth recovery under misinformation, providing a transparent baseline

contributions.purpose: 揭示带宽阈值与三种信息质量区制
contributions.mechanism: 扫描 B 与真值比例,分类 full/partial/no convergence
contributions.source_quote: we show bandwidth-dependent thresholds and identify three regimes—clean, boundary, and polluted

contributions.purpose: 发现 hub 脆弱性悖论
contributions.mechanism: 计算中心性与恢复表现的 Spearman ρ 并做 bootstrap CI
contributions.evaluation: clean 下 degree ρ 达 0.9;50% 边界 ρ≈0.2 崩塌;污染下反转 ρ≈-0.5(3,5 区 95%CI[-0.55,-0.44])
contributions.source_quote: we uncover and formalize the hub vulnerability paradox: in misinformation-rich settings, centrality becomes harmful
